Elliot (Finance): Heads-up: small but important procurement update tied to recurring subscriptions and vendor data. Short TL;DR below.

Cara (Eng): TL;DR please :eyes: we have a few new SaaS renewals coming up.

Elliot (Finance): TL;DR: 1) Recurring SaaS approvals: subscriptions > $1,500/year now need finance review (was $3k). 2) Capital purchase auto-approve threshold for equipment increased to $10k for infra-only items (still needs asset tag + depreciation code). 3) All vendor records must include a declared diversity tag (opt-out allowed with justification). 4) New vendor questionnaire link: https://intranet/redwood/finance/vendor-q.

Leah (Sales Ops): Is the SaaS change effective immediately? We have an annual calendar tool renewal next week.

Elliot (Finance): Effective immediately. If you already submitted a renewal, add note "recurring-exception" in the portal and we'll fast-track reviews for renewals within 14 days.

Tom (SupplyOps): Process note: subscriptions between $1.5k and $5k get a 48-hour SLA from Finance; >$5k goes to Director review. For infra equipment <= $10k, SupplyOps will auto-create asset tag and PO.

vendor-bot: New vendor questionnaire created for AcmeCalendars (submitted by cara). Link: https://intranet/redwood/vendors/acmecalendars/q/998. Status: pending security review.

Cara (Eng): Uploaded vendor questionnaire and cost breakdown. Question: does the diversity tag affect approval timelines?

Elliot (Finance): No, diversity tag is metadata only for reporting. If vendor opts out, include a short reason in the questionnaire. It won't delay approvals.

Leah (Sales Ops): For multi-year prepayments, do we still amortize? Example: 3-year contract paid upfront.

Elliot (Finance): Yes, multi-year prepayments for SaaS are amortized across contract term. Please include amortization schedule in the procurement request so accounting can code it properly.

Tom (SupplyOps): Quick operational: update runbooks to include the vendor-q link and `recurring-exception` tag for fast-tracks.

Elliot (Finance): We'll publish a 1-page guide and hold a 20-min office hour Thursday 11am PT. Also adding a checklist to #docs.

Cara (Eng): Thanks 44d will add to renewals runbook.

Elliot (Finance): One last reminder: company card limits unchanged; still required to upload receipts within 48h. Misreported subscription renewals may be reversed.

vendor-bot: Reminder: questionnaire 998 incomplete (missing W9). Please attach within 72h.
